intent: Replace the overly detailed otter with a deliberately illustrated 2D natural-history drawing

reference_roles.img/ocean/whale.webp: Navy/slate/ivory palette and painted drawing language only
reference_roles.img/ocean/turtle.webp: Palette and outlined illustrative form only

prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE transparent-background painted 2D sea otter illustration for a dark-blue ocean website. Redesign the subject from scratch as a restrained editorial natural-history drawing. This must be obviously DRAWN, not a photoreal animal, not a rendered plush toy. One adult sea otter floats on its back, head at upper RIGHT, body extending diagonally toward lower LEFT. Full-body wide 2:1 composition. Head is modestly proportioned, face turned slightly to the RIGHT rather than staring at camera, small dark eyes with no glossy catchlights, broad dark nose, short pale cheek/muzzle patches, a few economical ink whiskers. Two small forepaws rest loosely over chest, two broad webbed hind flippers at lower left; keep natural mammal anatomy and relaxed asymmetric posture. The floating belly and back read as simple rounded shapes, lower sides naturally below waterline. Style: confident slightly irregular dark contour line, THREE OR FOUR broad matte color shapes, subtle dry-brush paper texture in the fills, sparse hand-inked accents. Fur is expressed by just a few short directional marks at silhouette edges, NEVER thousands of individual hairs, NEVER white shredded stripes all over the body. Limited palette: deep navy #081d2b, muted steel blue #355c70, slate gray #839eaa, sparse cool light gray #c4d2d7 only on cheek/edges. No warm brown/tan. Dark navy is dominant so it belongs to the same blue ocean world as supplied whale/turtle references, but simplify detail dramatically. No bright white outlines, no electric cyan rim light, no starry or diamond eyes, no smile, no anthropomorphism, no mirror-symmetric feet pointing toward camera. Crisp readable silhouette at 300px wide. Include at most two simple thin navy/steel-blue ripple curves hugging the body, no solid water patch. Entire body, paws, flippers, tail and whiskers inside canvas with at least 5% clear padding on ALL sides. Genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside otter and the few ripple curves, no backdrop, no rectangle, no shadow, no halo, no checkerboard, no lettering.
